A0 is reported as a constant-scalar de-Sitter branch, with a commonly cited potential convention V(phi)=Lambda6+beta phi^2 and beta>=0.

ledger.content: MD-2S-B1.4N reports that the unrestricted linear system is algebraically solvable using a conical centre mode, while no global solution exists with fixed smooth centre and only minimal cap controls.
An additional independent geometric control is required before the B1.4O response-rank audit can be executed.

ledger.content: The exact historical independent radial ODE set, Hamiltonian constraint and algebraic dependency map are unavailable in the accessible indexed corpus.
The exact historical cap/localized action and oriented junction conventions are unavailable.
The definitions and integration conventions for V_W, R_circle, Xi_cap and lambda_eff are not all available as primary equations.
The current SCI-001/SCI-002 files define a later Einstein-Maxwell-scalar parent skeleton with GHY and cap/brane structure, but model identity with the historical A0 solver has not been established.
